messages:
ana-sec: Heads up: were rolling out the Delegated Credentials & Access Mapping policy today. Purpose: stop broad cross-project service access and require explicit role bindings + short-lived delegation tokens for cross-project calls. Owners must act.
omar-platform: Whats the enforcement timeline?

ana-sec: Discovery kicks off now. Enforcement (deny policy) will start in 7 days for non-exempt projects. If you need more time open an exemption.

viv-sre: What counts as cross-project? calls where SA in project-A is given roles on project-B?

ana-sec: Exactly. Triage priority: 1) bindings using "allUsers" or "roles/owner", 2) cross-project bindings to infra SAs, 3) SAs with console or broad iam.setIamPolicy perms.

policy-bot: Automated discovery report 1752001112: 27 cross-project bindings, 9 owner-role bindings, 4 SAs with console access. Full report: https://internal.redwood/policy/reports/1752001112

omar-platform: Sharing a mapping script: `scripts/map-crossproj.sh --org org-id > crossmap.json` Use it to identify owners.

viv-sre: For services that must call across projects, prefer short-lived delegation tokens via `gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate --impersonate-service-account=... --duration=3600` or AWS STS AssumeRole with limited session tags.

kelly-ps: If a private customer deployment depends on cross-project roles, how do we avoid breaking them?

ana-sec: Open a private-deploy exemption ticket with account-ops and sec-oncall. We'll coordinate a controlled migration to delegated tokens.

omar-platform: Quick remediation tips: remove owner bindings, replace with least-priv roles, add documented justification in the binding comment. We'll provide a bulk-PR template.

policy-bot: Reminder: new policy name `deny_cross_project_wide_bindings_v1` will be applied in dry-run for 72h starting now, then enforced in 7 days.

viv-sre: Noting: test token refresh for long-running agents. We saw failures when TTL < cron interval. Test and adjust TTLs accordingly.

ana-sec: Owners: create remediation issues for flagged items within 72h. Failure to file will trigger automated remediation (role removal) after enforcement window.

kelly-ps: I'll notify impacted customers if account-ops signals risk. Thanks for the heads-up.

omar-platform: I'll post the bulk-PR template and the `map-crossproj.sh` usage in #devex.

ana-sec: Thanks. This is a posture change to comply with our Delegated Credentials standard. Ping sec-oncall for urgent breaks. :lock:
